name: Nazca Lines
blurb: Located in the Nazca Desert of southern Peru, the Nazca Lines are a UNESCO World Heritage site featuring giant ancient geoglyphs etched into the desert plains. Visitors frequently experience the site through flights over the area to view the extensive geometric shapes and animal figures.

positive: Exceeded expectations on flights over the lines
Incredible scale visible from the air
negative: Illegal mining destroying the site and local water
Plane crashes reported over the famed area

quotes.text:
Nazca Lines is a popular tourist attraction and UNESCO World Heritage site in southern Peru that features ancient drawings in desert sand.
This isn't the first plane to crash over the famed site in the last few decades.

The Unavoidable Truth: Illegal mining is destroying the Nazca Lines and local water.

The Unavoidable Lie: The government can solve this through standard negotiation.

So, I know I've been off here for a while.

Some friends have prompted me to drop back in.

Last year I ticked off one of those bucket things; a flight over the Nasca lines.

Terrible photos; but it exceeded all expectations.

(I'm not planning on popping my clogs anytime soon)
